findings: Optional StableAdamW uses parameter gradients as scratch during step and reports only the final parameter group norm through self.grad_norms; capture genuine gradients before optimizer.step.

Optional sequence packing drops a partial outgoing batch if any packed row is empty, reverses deferred sequence order using extendleft, preserves an intentional strict-greater buffer refill condition, counts the padding tail as a sequence through cumulative offsets, and samples random MLM replacements only up to the post-mask batch maximum token rather than the full vocabulary. These semantics belong to the optional text-packing route, not automatically the native ARG loader.
EfficientCrossEntropy averages already-reduced batch losses equally; token-weighted recomputation has different weighting when valid masked token counts differ.
Optional padded RoPE attention dispatch checks global IMPL_USE_FLASH2 in forward rather than self.use_fa2; installed FlashAttention can override an explicit false configuration in this variant.
